The day of the Tokyo Daishoten had 
arrived. Oi Racecourse was packed with an 
unthinkable number of spectators.

Thanks to the grassroots efforts of fans 
answering Smart Falcon's passion, it 
became their biggest stage with the 
largest turnout in history.

Smart Falcon feels she couldn't possibly 
be happier. Well, if there was one thing 
that could top it—

Namely, to shine upon this ultimate stage. 
To become a top Umadol, she headed toward 
her crowning Tour Final.
